_about: Gun TRAITS (locked 2026-11-14, diary/DECISIONS_SEA.md: a layer above the small buffs, like Borderlands anointments): build-defining effects. A gun of a tier listed in slots_by_tier rolls that many (purple and gold one, orange and up two), each at a quality inside its tier's range, never the same twice; the value goes from min to max with the quality. Effects: game/gun_traits.gd. desc is printf-style (one %s for the value, a literal % written %%). ALL NUMBERS ARE PLACEHOLDERS FOR THE DIRECTOR. Traits with a `family` are PONY-ONLY (data/pony_families.json): a pony gun's first trait is one of its family's, the second from the common pool; other tiers never roll them.
